items.followUp: Convert (1101)₂ into the Decimal Number System.

rubric.why: Award for correctly expanding the binary number using powers of 2.
rubric.description: Shows the place-value expansion of the binary number.
rubric.how: Check that the digits are multiplied by the corresponding powers of 2, or that the correct expanded sum is shown.

rubric.why: Award for the correct decimal result.
rubric.how: Check that the final answer is 11.

items.followUp: Which number system is used for counting in everyday life, and what is its base?

rubric.why: Identifies the number system used in everyday life.
Gives the base of the decimal number system.
rubric.how: Check for the number 10 as the base.

modelAnswer: The Decimal Number System is used in our daily life.

items.followUp: What is the function of the logical AND operator?

rubric.why: Identifies NOT as an operator that works on one operand.
rubric.description: States that the NOT operator is unary or operates on one condition.
rubric.how: Check for either the term unary or an equivalent reference to one operand.

rubric.why: Describes how NOT reverses a logical value.
rubric.description: States that NOT reverses or complements the logical result.
rubric.how: Check for a reversal/complement description or both true and false.

modelAnswer: The Logical NOT operator is a unary operator that works on one logical value or condition.
It reverses the logical value: true becomes false, and false becomes true.

items.followUp: What is a client in a client-server network?

rubric.why: Explains the role of the client.
rubric.description: States that a client sends a request to a server.
rubric.how: Check for both the client and its request.

rubric.why: Explains the role of the server in the arrangement.
rubric.description: States that the server provides a service/resource or responds to the client.
rubric.how: Check for the server and a service, resource, or response.

modelAnswer: In a client-server network, a client requests data or services from a server.
The server processes the request and provides the required data or service.

rubric.why: Identifies the arrangement of devices in a ring topology.
rubric.description: States that the devices form a ring or circular arrangement.

rubric.why: Describes how each device is connected in the topology.
rubric.description: States that each device connects to two neighbouring devices (or the next devices) to form the ring.
rubric.how: Check for the two-neighbour connection or equivalent wording.

modelAnswer: In a Ring Topology, each computer or device is connected to two neighbouring devices.
The connections form a closed circular path or ring.

items.followUp: What is the purpose of an IP address on a network?

rubric.why: Identifies the IP address as an address assigned to a network device.
rubric.description: States that an IP address is a logical or unique address.
rubric.how: Check for a logical or unique address.

rubric.why: Explains what the address enables on a network.
rubric.description: States that it identifies a device or enables network communication.
rubric.how: Check for device identification or communication over a network.

modelAnswer: IP addressing assigns a logical address to a device on a network.
The IP address identifies the device and enables it to communicate with other devices.

items.followUp: Which HTML tag is used to create a row in a table?

rubric.why: Names the HTML tag used to make a table.
rubric.how: Check for <table> or the phrase table tag.

rubric.why: Shows the purpose of the tag.
rubric.description: States that the tag creates or defines an HTML table.
rubric.how: Check for a statement linking the tag to creating a table or its rows and cells.

modelAnswer: The <table> tag is used to create a table in HTML.
Table rows and cells are placed inside the table element.

items.followUp: What is the purpose of the href attribute in an HTML anchor tag?

rubric.how: Check for <a> or the phrase anchor tag.

rubric.why: Explains what an anchor is used for.
rubric.description: States that it creates a hyperlink to another page or destination.
rubric.how: Check for a hyperlink or a link to a destination.

modelAnswer: The Anchor is created using the <a> tag in HTML.
It is used to create a hyperlink to another page or destination.
